raw_text: The main road from Muzaffarpur to Sitamarhi is completely broken after rains. Ambulances cannot pass. Please repair urgently.
No clean drinking water in our village for 3 months. Women walk 4 km daily. Jal Jeevan Mission not reached us yet.
Primary school building collapsed in monsoon. 180 children studying under tree. Need new classrooms and toilets.
Frequent power cuts of 8-10 hours daily in coastal villages. Affects fishing and students studies.
Hand pumps dried up. Water tanker comes once in 10 days. Livestock dying. Need pipeline connection.
Nearest PHC is 28 km away. No ambulance service. Pregnant women suffer a lot. Need sub-centre here.
Bridge on Ken river washed away. Villages cut off for 4 months every year. Need permanent bridge.
Embankment breached again. Floods every year destroy crops and houses. Strengthen Brahmaputra embankment.
No toilets in school or village. Open defecation continues. Swachh Bharat not implemented properly here.
No high school within 12 km. Girls drop out after class 8. Need secondary school urgently.
Arsenic contaminated water. Many people falling sick. Need safe water treatment plant.
Only one doctor for 50,000 people. Medicines always out of stock. Upgrade CHC facilities.
Forest road to 12 villages is non-existent in monsoon. Tribal children cannot go to school.
Solar pumps promised but not installed. Farmers dependent on diesel. Need renewable energy support.
Irrigation canal damaged. 3000 acres no water this season. Repair urgently for rabi crop.
School has only 2 teachers for 5 classes. Mid-day meal irregular. Quality education missing.
NH connection incomplete. Farmers lose money transporting produce. Complete the missing 18 km stretch.
No blood bank within 80 km. Emergency cases die on way. Need blood storage facility.
Desert villages still without electricity. Solar microgrids promised under Saubhagya not delivered.
Tribal hamlets have no water source. Dependence on streams which dry up. Need tube wells and pipelines.
Hill road to tea estates damaged. Landslides common. Need retaining walls and proper drainage.
No digital classroom or computer lab. Students lag behind. Need smart class infrastructure.
Annual flooding destroys paddy. Need raised platforms and better drainage system.
Open drains and garbage everywhere. Disease outbreaks common. Need proper sewage and waste management.
No specialist doctors. Patients travel to Siliguri for everything. Upgrade district hospital.
Multiple requests for same stretch of NH-104. Completely unmotorable after rains.
Another request from neighbouring village - same water crisis. Tanker insufficient.
Parents demanding permanent building. Temporary shed not safe for children.
Water quality very poor - high fluoride. Dental and bone problems increasing.
Still waiting for the sub-centre. Two more maternal deaths reported this month.
